quote: Was there anyone else with you on the title of the home?
stewart_read: Son is on title — this triggers the adult-child co-decision-maker protocol, but rep doesn't secure his direct involvement until button-up.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep could be deliberately deferring full inclusion until the appointment-set stage rather than mid-call — but the credit and utility questions right after show he still treats Barbara as primary respondent, undercutting that read.
coaching_implication: When co-owner is identified, rep should immediately ask if the son can join the call or at least get his direct contact for the closer.

quote: I don't know. My son handles that.
stewart_read: Rep says 'okay, no worries' and moves on instead of probing whether son should be looped in for this and the remaining financial questions.
coaching_implication: This is the second signal (after co-owner reveal) that Barbara isn't the qualified respondent — rep should pivot to scheduling the son onto the call itself, not just onto the eventual appointment.

quote: Do you do you or your son have a credit score above 670?
stewart_read: Rep asks Barbara to answer the credit qualifier on behalf of her son, who is the actual financial decision-maker — this is a self-report through a proxy who has already said she doesn't know the household's finances.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may be trying to keep the call moving efficiently rather than stall on logistics — reactive expediency, not strategy, since no plan is made to verify with the son directly.
coaching_implication: Flag for closer: credit qualifier answer is unverified and came from someone who explicitly disclaims financial knowledge.

quote: I don't know. We haven't lived here that long.
stewart_read: Bill collection fails and rep pivots to move-in date instead of finding an alternate path (e.g., asking the son to text the bill before Monday).
coaching_implication: Rep should have said something like 'no worries — can you have your son send that over before Monday so the design is accurate?' to keep the anchor alive instead of dropping it.

quote: I do see that big tree kinda in front. Is that still there by chance?
stewart_read: Rep goes into shading/tree-trim discussion in detail, which edges into design-consultant territory rather than simple qualification.
alternative_hypothesis: This could be a legitimate roof/shading qualifier check, not true scope creep, since tree shading is a hard technical gate for solar feasibility.
coaching_implication: Acceptable as a qualifying question, but rep should keep it brief rather than narrating what he sees on the shade coverage in detail.

quote: I'll get everything started for you above right now, and then our specialist will just drop by and plan to talk to your you and your son on Monday at ten
stewart_read: Rep never asks 'is that fair?' or explicitly confirms Barbara will ensure her son is present — the appointment closes without the verbal handshake or a locked commitment on son's attendance.
coaching_implication: Add explicit line: 'Can you make sure your son is available too since he's on the title?' before ending the call.
